description.narrative: A Public Private Development Partnership through which the organization Sustainable Fisheries Partnerships and the company Abba Seafood aim to create a more socially and environmentally sustainable tonggol fishery and fishing governance structures in the region through broad stakeholder dialogues and regional cooperation between tuna suppliers, buyers, fishermen and fishery authorities.

Ett Public Private Development Partnership mellan Sustainable Fisheries Partnerships och företaget Abba Seafood för ett mer socialt och miljömässigt hållbart tonggolfiske i regionen. Projektet avser att genom en bred intressentdialog och regionalt samarbete mellan tonfiskleverantörer, uppköpare, fiskare, CSO:er och myndigheter utveckla och få till stånd hållbar fiskeförvalting för tonggolfiske.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The Thai Department of Fisheries (DOF) has produced an initial draft of the Tonggol management plan. Some advances have been made in 2015 by the Thai authorities to regulate the registration and use of migrant worker crew. Sustainable Fisheries Partnership (SFP) has worked with WWF and Simplot to take over the Fisheries Improvement Project (FIP) for Tonggol tuna. These organisations have shown interest but in that case the FIP will have a strict Thai focus.
